payload.title: p.apyr.us page: scheduled publishing and automated announcements
payload.description:
Part of the scheduled publishing and announcements epic. Design: docs/plans/scheduled-publishing-and-announcements.md.

Goal: a p.apyr.us feature page explaining scheduling (pick a time, suggested times, the schedule view) and announcements (what qualifies, the owner's own X account and keys, approval, budget and pause), with screenshots from MoM's newsroom, in the site's voice (no speed bragging; no claims of production use we cannot back).

Depends on: the schedule view story and the cost story.

```gherkin
Feature: Prospective publishers can learn how scheduling and announcements work
  Every Papyrus feature epic ends with a page on p.apyr.us.

  Scenario: The page explains the feature in plain words
    When a visitor opens the scheduled publishing page on p.apyr.us
    Then it explains choosing times, suggested times and the schedule view
    And it explains that announcements post on the publisher's own X account, only for Stories that meet the publisher's bar, within a budget the publisher sets, with a pause switch

  Scenario: Screenshots show real screens
    Then each screenshot is from the real newsroom, with any account names and keys hidden
```
